statBlock.name: Dragon Blessed
statBlock.description: An acolyte who reveres a dragon as a god and uses magic to heal its allies and punish its enemies.

sections.Languages: Common, Draconic, and two other languages.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks, choosing Mace or Radiant Bolt for each.
Mace. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) radiant damage.
Radiant Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +6 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. A hit deals 22 (5d8) radiant damage and restores 5 (1d10) hit points to the blessed.
Spellcasting. Cast one listed spell using Wisdom (spell save DC 14).
At will. Light, Thaumaturgy.
1/day each. Enhance Ability, Flame Strike, Mass Cure Wounds, Revivify, Tongues.
sections.Dragon followers: Dragon followers take cues from their patron dragon. Some serve it directly, while others follow it to learn the secrets of dragonkind. A Blessed can support a Dragon Chosen guarding a Dragon Speaker.

statBlock.name: Dragon Chosen
statBlock.description: A warrior who takes on a patron dragon’s power and enforces its will, often guarding a Dragon Speaker.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Handaxe attack and two Shortsword attacks.
Handaxe. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage. The axe returns magically to the chosen’s hand immediately after a ranged attack, whether it hits or misses.
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.
sections.Reactions: Biting Rebuke. Immediately after taking damage from a creature within 5 ft., the chosen can make a Shortsword attack against that creature with advantage.

statBlock.name: Dragon Speaker
statBlock.description: A dragon’s envoy who negotiates for supplies, alliances, and treasure. The same voice can calm a crowd or knock a foe backward.

sections.Languages: Common, Draconic, and two other languages.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Thunder Bolt attacks.
Thunder Bolt. Melee or ranged spell attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (3d8) thunder damage and pushes the target horizontally up to 10 ft. away from the speaker.
Spellcasting. Cast one listed spell using Charisma (spell save DC 13).
At will. Dancing Lights.
1/day each. Calm Emotions, Charm Person, Command, Comprehend Languages.
sections.Reactions: Disarming Words (3/day). When a visible creature within 60 ft. rolls damage, the speaker can roll 1d6 and subtract the result from that damage roll.

statBlock.name: Dragon Turtle Wyrmling
statBlock.description: A young dragon turtle that swims through coastal waters. One might make its home in a geyser among steam mephits.

sections.Traits: Amphibious. The wyrmling breathes air and water.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (1d12 + 3) piercing damage.
Steam Breath (Recharge 5–6). The wyrmling exhales a 15-ft. cone of steam. Each creature in the cone makes a DC 12 Dexterity save, taking 17 (5d6) fire damage on a failure or half on a success. Being underwater grants no resistance to this damage.
sections.Source notes: Page 192 gives Bite as 9 (1d12 + 3) and calls for a Dexterity save against Steam Breath. The standard rounded-down average of the Bite dice is also 9.
sections.Optional dragon customization: Chapter 3 (p. 34) offers optional changes to languages, skill and tool proficiencies, senses, and traits.

statBlock.name: Dragonblood Ooze
statBlock.description: An alchemical accident that gave congealed dragon blood a will of its own. It can briefly shape itself like a dragon before collapsing into a heap.

sections.Condition immunities: Blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, prone, restrained.
sections.Senses: Blindsight 120 ft. The ooze is blind beyond that radius.
sections.Languages: Understands Draconic and its creator’s languages. It cannot speak.
sections.Traits:
Amorphous. The ooze fits through a space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.
Spider Climb. The ooze can climb difficult surfaces and cross ceilings upside down without a check.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Pseudopod attacks, or replace one with Slime Breath when available.
Pseudopod. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (1d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) acid damage. A Large or smaller creature hit is grappled (escape DC 15) and takes 7 (2d6) acid damage at the start of each of its turns until the grapple ends.
Slime Breath (Recharge 6). The ooze ejects part of its body in a 30-ft. cone. Each creature in the cone makes a DC 14 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 22 (4d10) acid damage and is pulled up to 30 ft. straight toward the ooze. On a success, it takes half damage and stays where it is.

statBlock.name: Dragonbone Golem
statBlock.description: A dragon animates the etched bones of defeated rivals and binds them with adamantine wire to make a lair guardian.

sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned.
sections.Languages: Understands Draconic and its creator’s languages. It cannot speak.
sections.Traits:
Fear Aura. When a creature of the golem’s choice starts its turn within 20 ft., it makes a DC 15 Wisdom save unless the golem is incapacitated. A failure leaves it frightened until the start of its next turn. A success grants 24 hours of immunity to this golem’s aura.
Magic Resistance. The golem makes saves against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
Unusual Nature. The golem needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Pinion attack and two Rend attacks.
Pinion. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage. A Medium or smaller creature hit is pinned and restrained. Each of the golem’s two pinions can restrain one creature. An occupied pinion cannot attack. At the start of its turn, the restrained creature can free itself with a DC 17 Strength (Athletics) check.
Rend. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) necrotic damage.
Petrifying Breath (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 60-ft. cone makes a DC 15 Constitution save. A failure deals 35 (10d6) poison damage and restrains the creature while it starts to turn to stone. The restrained creature repeats the save at the end of its next turn. The effect ends on a success and petrifies it on a failure.
